args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10th - June 20th, 2024

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- High SPF sunscreen (reef-safe recommended)
- Hiking gear (comfortable shoes, hat, water bottle)
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable clothing)
- Camera (with waterproof case for snorkeling)
- Travel documents (passport/ID, hotel confirmations, flight details)

Additional Recommended Items:
- Beach towel
- Sunglasses
- Light rain jacket (for possible showers)
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel)
- Insect repellent
- Reusable water bottle
- Power adapter/charger
- Small backpack for day trips
- Flip flops/sandals
- Dressier outfit for the Luau (June 16)
- Spa attire (June 17)
- Shopping bag (for June 19 shopping trip)

Activities to Pack For:
- Beach day at Waikiki Beach (June 11)
- Snorkeling at Hanauma Bay (June 12)
- Hiking at Diamond Head (June 13)
- Visit to Pearl Harbor (June 14)
- Road trip to the North Shore (June 15)
- Luau experience at Polynesian Cultural Center (June 16)
- Relaxation day at hotel spa (June 17)
- Kayaking at Kailua Beach (June 18)
- Shopping at Ala Moana Center (June 19)
